verdict.rationale: Undermind documents a narrow form of event-triggered automation. Users can save topics that are monitored, and an alert is sent when relevant new papers are published, including role-aware updates for enterprise teams. This is a fixed alert behavior, not a general user-defined rule engine. Missing for 10: configurable rule/condition definitions, a choice of triggered actions beyond notifications, a broader set of event types, and hands-on or independent corroboration of the alerting feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Get notified whenever relevant papers are published.
Monitors saved topics and sends concise updates tailored to each teammate’s role and active projects.
